description: Ready Check session rule, task records and finished-task reminder.

hooks.command: python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook session-start --client codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook session-start --client codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook session-start --client codex

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook prompt --client codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook prompt --client codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook prompt --client codex

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook answer --client codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook answer --client codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook answer --client codex

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook stop --client codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook stop --client codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook stop --client codex
